Table 1. Recovery of PVDF binder.
| Paper | Recovery of PVDF binder |
| --- | --- |
| Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials | Not removed or dissolved during the EG-based separation process, as confirmed by FTIR and EDX spectra. |
| Sustainable recycling of cathode scraps via Cyrene-based separation | Recovered through a thermally induced phase separation (TIPS) process, where the supernatant was composed of PVDF and CB in Cyrene. By cooling down the hot supernatant to room temperature, phase separation occurred in which PVDF polymer precipitated out together with the residual CB particles.
